Let me compute a comprehensive risk/weakness score per (Login Method, 2FA Method) combination. Let me also look at whether anomalies correlate with failures.

Actually, the "Authentication Methods" in the task probably refers to the Two-Factor Authentication Methods (SMS, Email, APP verification code) combined with Login Methods (Password Login, Scan Code Login, Fingerprint authentication, SMS verification code).

Let me look at the authentication_methods_table for the relevant 2FA-related methods: SMS verification code, Email verification code, APP verification code (maybe "Dynamic Token" or "APP verification code" isn't in the table). Let me check what methods correspond to the 2FA used.

Actually the login records use "APP verification code" as a 2FA method, but the auth methods table has "Dynamic Token", "Email verification code", "SMS verification code", "Fingerprint recognition", "QR Code Scanning", "Password Login", etc.

Let me query the auth methods table for the relevant names and security levels aggregated.

function.name: dacomp_query_db
function.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT "Authentication Method Name",
       COUNT(*) AS n,
       ROUND(AVG("security level"),1) AS avg_sec_level,
       ROUND(AVG("Authentication Priority"),1) AS avg_priority,
       SUM(CASE WHEN "Enabled"='Enabled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS enabled_count,
       ROUND(AVG("Maximum Attempts"),1) AS avg_max_attempts,
       ROUND(AVG("Lockout Duration"),1) AS avg_lockout
FROM authentication_methods_table
WHERE "Authentication Method Name" IN ('SMS verification code','Email verification code','Dynamic Token','Fingerprint recognition','QR Code Scanning','Password Login')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY avg_sec_level DESC"}

function.name: dacomp_query_db
function.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT se."Severity", COUNT(*) AS cnt, ROUND(AVG(se."Risk Score"),1) AS avg_risk

WHERE substr(lr."Login Time",1,4)='2024'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY avg_risk DESC"}
